name: nshm23_wus_grid
source: nshm-conus active-crust/grid branch-averaged WUS gridded seismicity (2023 NSHM)

point_source.notes: Distances from the epicentral distance with the ucla_plha crustal approximations: Rjb from the Thompson and Worden (2017) style magnitude-dependent correction, dip, Ztor and Zbor from Kaklamanos et al. (2011), and Rrup fit to Thompson and Worden (2017).

notes: point_source keeps the ucla_plha crustal distance treatment. nshmp_point_source records the nshm-conus 6.2.0 active-crust/grid/grid-config.json settings used by nshmp-lib (not used by default; set point_source to these values to use the nshmp-lib point-source distances).
